findings.description: The opencode plugin copy action's `from`/`target` paths were renamed to `agentspine.js`, but the source template file was never renamed on disk (it's still `templates/agents/plugins/opencode/agent-init.js`), so the copy throws ENOENT for any default scaffold with opencode selected.

BLOCK_START/BLOCK_END markers moved from `<!-- agent-init:start -->` to `<!-- agentspine:start -->`; since `spliceManagedBlock` matches the old marker by exact string, any file already carrying the old marker would get a second block appended instead of updated in place — moot here since nothing was ever published under the old name, but worth a one-time grep if any internal or dogfood repo already has old markers.

Decision 25's "Cost accepted: a rename across 45 files" undercounts (the PR actually touches 46) and doesn't disclose that one of those files' rename is incomplete (the opencode plugin template, see the correctness finding above) — AGENTS.md asks decisions to honestly record the cost accepted, and this one reads as a completed, low-risk rename when it isn't quite.

The file's intro still says "The nine decisions that define `agentspine`" even though it now runs through decision 25 — stale before this PR (only the backticked name was substituted here), not introduced by this diff.

process_issues.description: I briefed reviewers that only AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and the top-level .agents/quality.toml were in the CI config-restore set. The actual working tree at run start showed the entire templates/ subtree (hook adapters, quality.toml, skill docs, the opencode plugin, the rendered workflow) also reset to base-branch bytes — one reviewer's own inspection of the emitted workflow found `RESTORE_PATHS: "AGENTS.md .agents templates"`, confirming templates/ is restored too. Reviewers who relied on `Read`/`find` directly against templates/ paths (instead of `git diff`/`git show HEAD:<path>`) would have seen stale base-branch content and could have missed real changes there. Most reviewers self-corrected by using git-based reads, but this was luck rather than an accurate brief; the restore-set list in future briefs should be verified against the workflow's actual RESTORE_PATHS rather than assumed from the skill's example list.
